seen.where: IIIF manifest c8490bb4-f0bf-41a3-bd85-4c41aead033f, canvases 0059r (47ad723c...) and 0059v (d72c664d...), downloaded 4 Nov 2026 to scratch. The server caps a request at 1200 px wide, so 59r was read whole and again in five overlapping bands (scale about 40%); 59v whole, plus the margin crop at full scale.
seen.extent: All of 59r: about 24 lines mixing clear Spanish with Greek-capital-like signs (B, T, Y, Omega, Lambda, Sigma, Psi and others), the last two lines wholly clear. 59v: blank except a Campori stamp and one short vertical cipher line in the outer margin.
seen.cipher: Every cipher run on 59r, band by band from 'dia de gran toque' at the top to the last cipher line above the two clear closing lines, has a letter-by-letter gloss in a smaller hand written over it; a recurring sign group carries one abbreviation mark. I found no unglossed cipher run. The margin line on 59v is glossed too, roughly 'cifra con su de...' (end not made out).

seen.where: Lodovico/IIIF, Donati, Sigismondo: c. 1 b5c4fc9a, c. 2 64ef953a, c. 3 5907be21-6d78-4031-a033-c9787b16ddd1, c. 4 b15b5995-1377-41fc-9dc1-0d1cfc663514. Rectos read at 1200 px with crops of 3r and 1r, versos at 400-1200 px. cc. 5-16 (other records in the folder) looked at on a 400 px contact sheet only.
seen.extent: c. 3r about 21 lines and c. 4r 9 lines of continuous digits with a few clear words; 3v and 4v carry no cipher, only show-through and, on 4v, a docket. c. 1r 19 lines and c. 2r 8 lines of Italian clear.
seen.cipher: cc. 3-4 are both headed 'Di Roma li XI di Marzo 1617', foot note 'a Mons. Nunzio in Francia'; a figure cipher in unspaced digits. Clear words left in the cipher agree with the clear leaves: 'gia', 'haura', 'hauendo' on 3r in c. 1r; 'per il quale' and 'hauena' three times on 4r in c. 2r. Word-level comparison only, no digit-by-digit collation. c. 1r and c. 2r are dated the same day. No interlinear gloss on cc. 3-4.

seen.where: Genziana Ricci, 'La lettera cifrata di Lucrezia Borgia', Il Giornalino (Storie di Pianura), archive.org item giornalino-lettera-cifrata-lucrezia-borgia_202501, read in its OCR text, which shows a reproduction of the letter and a transcription. Lodovico record 8f9df0a4 read: 'NOTE: Lettera cifrata', shelfmark as in the lead, no IIIF manifest (404). The facsimile image itself was not viewed; ASMo's original was not seen.
seen.extent: One letter, about 12-14 lines going by the OCR of the reproduction; exact extent not measured.
seen.cipher: Ricci describes 'simboli grafici ed alfabetici' and prints the deciphered text, dated Ferrara 8 Oct 1510, on the fall of Stellata, signed Lucretia, with a few [...] gaps, and a contemporary note: 'Cavossi questa cum la ziffra da Mantua'.
